items.title: London Clinic partners with Grosvenor Orthopaedic Partners
items.summary: The London Clinic has partnered with Grosvenor Orthopaedic Partners, bringing 25 surgeons and consultants into a refurbished outpatient site at 20 Devonshire Place to expand orthopaedic activity.

items.title: Stryker stock falls on slower peripheral vascular, hip sales
items.summary: Stryker shares fell after the cyberattack on its Microsoft environment (confirmed 04/09) disrupted its peripheral vascular business, acquired last year, and hip sales weakened. Stock down more than 10% in the week following the incident.

items.title: The idea was only one piece of the puzzle: what building a business really takes
items.summary: By James Scott, CEO and Co-Founder at Orthofuse When people talk about innovation, the idea tends to get most of the attention. It is the breakthrough, the thing that is easiest to explain. But once you try to turn that idea into a business, the technology quickly becomes one piece of a much bigger puzzle.

items.title: Robotic hip and knee surgery fails to cut overall risk of repeat surgery
items.summary: Two major studies from the University of Oxford, Queen Mary University of London and the University of Bristol, have found that robotic-assisted hip and knee replacement does not reduce the overall early risk of repeat surgery compared with conventional surgery.

items.title: Arthrex strengthens commitment to joint preservation through partnership with ICRS
items.summary: Arthrex, a global leader in minimally invasive surgical technology, announced a partnership with the International Cartilage Regeneration & Joint Preservation Society (ICRS), building on a long-standing collaboration and strengthening efforts to advance cartilage restoration and joint preservation worldwide.

items.title: Leda Orthopaedics wins 4-year GSTT contract to supply Integrum's OPRA osseointegration implant system
items.summary: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded Leda Orthopaedics Limited a contract worth £89,359.29, with an option to extend by up to two years, to supply Integrum's OPRA Implant System for private patients who are upper and lower limb amputees.

items.title: New research highlights need for surgeon peer support as RCS England launches SUPPORT2
items.summary: More than 88% of surgeons surveyed say surgeon-specific peer support is needed, as RCS England launches SUPPORT2 with 16 new and five returning site teams. The Royal College of Surgeons of England (RCS England) recently launched SUPPORT2, the next phase of its surgeon peer-support improvement programme.

items.title: The race to replace CoCr in hip and knee implants
items.summary: The global hip and knee replacement market exceeds US$21 billion in 2026. items.title: Researcher in Focus Q&A with Olly Morgan
items.summary: Olly Morgan is Co-Founder & CEO of Vitalis Ortho. His career has taken him from academic research and engineering to building and leading start-ups.

items.title: Level of education most strongly linked to survival after hip fracture
items.summary: Level of education is the socio-economic factor most strongly associated with survival rates after acute hip surgery. This is shown in a Linköping University study of 58,000 people. The results can be used to better identify patients who may need more support after surgery.

items.title: Decision support identifies people at high hip fracture risk
items.summary: Preventing hip fractures depends on identifying people at high risk early. Researchers at the University of Gothenburg have now developed a new clinical decision support tool that makes this possible—without requiring clinic visits or patient questionnaires.

items.title: Pathway for block-only hand and wrist surgery supports providers to reduce waiting times
items.summary: GIRFT has published a pathway for block-only (regional anaesthesia, no GA) hand and wrist surgery, aimed at helping providers cut waiting times and increase theatre throughput.

items.title: 11 November 2026, Implants 2026; France
items.summary: On the 100th SOFCOT Congress, Ali Madani, Founder and Managing Partner of Avicenne Consulting, invites you to his annual conference on the strategic challenges facing the orthopaedic industry and its contract manufacturing ecosystem — implants, instruments, robotics and manufacturing technologies.
